caption_L1: This is a line diagram titled Number of drug-related deaths due to barbiturate use in England and Wales from 1993 to 2019. The x-axis measures Year while the y-axis shows Number of deaths.
caption_L2L3: The amount of deaths due to barbiturate was very high in 1995 and decreased from that peak until 2005. From 2005 the number of deaths has been increasing before peaking in 2013. The deaths have slightly came down compared to 2013 numbers.
